tasks.contract: stop_any must fire when any sub-stop fires so the earliest deadline ends retries; requiring all stops delays the attempt-stop-end chain to the latest deadline.
tasks.body:
from tenacity import RetryCallState, Retrying
from tenacity.stop import stop_any, stop_after_attempt
combined=stop_any(stop_after_attempt(2), stop_after_attempt(5))
ctl=Retrying()
state=RetryCallState(ctl,None,(),{})
decisions=[]
for attempt in (1,2,3,5,6):
    state.attempt_number=attempt
    decisions.append(combined(state))
print('stop_any_call_sequence',decisions)
assert decisions==[False,True,True,True,True]

tasks.contract: Jittered exponential wait must keep initial/max/exp_base/jitter roles so sleeps grow exponentially within bounds; rotating the four arguments collapses every sleep to the cap across the attempt-sleep-end chain.
tasks.body:
import random
from tenacity import RetryCallState, Retrying
from tenacity.wait import wait_exponential_jitter
random.seed(1)
strat=wait_exponential_jitter()
state=RetryCallState(Retrying(),None,(),{})
values=[]
for attempt in (1,2,3):
    state.attempt_number=attempt
    values.append(strat(state))
print('jitter_init_sequence',values)
assert values==[1.134364244112401, 2.8474337369372327, 4.763774618976614]

tasks.contract: Waiting for no-echo must poll the echo flag until it clears or the timeout expires; deleting the poll loop returns None immediately, breaking the spawn-poll-detect chain.
tasks.body:
from ptyprocess import PtyProcess
proc=PtyProcess.spawn(['sleep','5'])
try:
    proc.setecho(False)
    first=proc.waitnoecho(timeout=5)
    proc.setecho(True)
    second=proc.waitnoecho(timeout=1)
    print('waitnoecho_sequence',[first,second])
    assert [first,second]==[True,False]
finally:
    try: proc.terminate(force=True)
    except Exception: pass
    try: proc.wait()
    except Exception: pass
    try: proc.close()
    except Exception: pass

tasks.contract: Update flush must invoke the callback on queued rows, sort and group by keys into update_many calls, then clear the queue; clearing first persists nothing and reports empty across the queue-flush-persist chain.
tasks.body:
from dataset.chunked import ChunkedUpdate
seen=[]; calls=[]
class T:
    def update_many(self, rows, keys): calls.append((list(rows),keys))
t=T()
up=ChunkedUpdate(t, keys=['id'], chunksize=100, callback=lambda q: seen.append(len(q)))
with up as u:
    enter_ok=(u is up)
    u.update({'id':1,'v':'a'})
    u.update({'id':2,'v':'b'})
print('flush_order_sequence',[enter_ok,seen,len(calls),len(up.queue)])
assert [enter_ok,seen,len(calls),len(up.queue)]==[True,[2],1,0]
assert calls[0]==([{'id':1,'v':'a'},{'id':2,'v':'b'}],['id'])

tasks.contract: Registering iteration actions must append each action exactly once in order; duplicating the first and dropping the rest corrupts the begin-retry-post execution chain.
tasks.body:
from tenacity import Retrying, RetryCallState, stop_after_attempt
ctl=Retrying(stop=stop_after_attempt(3))
calls=[]
def f1(rs): calls.append('f1')
def f2(rs): calls.append('f2')
ctl._add_action_func(f1)
n1=len(ctl.iter_state.actions)
ctl._add_action_func(f2)
n2=len(ctl.iter_state.actions)
state=RetryCallState(ctl,None,(),{})
for a in list(ctl.iter_state.actions):
    a(state)
print('add_action_sequence',[n1,n2,calls])
assert [n1,n2,calls]==[1,2,['f1','f2']]

tasks.contract: stop_after_delay must keep the exact max seconds so the deadline fires on time; taking abs plus a tenth delays every stop decision across the attempt-time-stop chain.
tasks.body:
import time
from tenacity import RetryCallState, Retrying
from tenacity.stop import stop_after_delay
stop=stop_after_delay(10)
assert stop.max_delay==10
ctl=Retrying()
decisions=[]
for dt in (9.9,10.0,10.1):
    state=RetryCallState(ctl,None,(),{})
    state.start_time=time.monotonic()-dt
    state.set_result('v')
    decisions.append(stop(state))
print('stop_delay_sequence',decisions)
assert decisions==[False,True,True]

tasks.contract: Async action registration must append in order so begin runs before retry checks; prepending reverses the begin-retry-post execution chain.
tasks.body:
import asyncio
from tenacity import RetryCallState, Retrying, stop_after_attempt
from tenacity.asyncio import AsyncRetrying
ctl=AsyncRetrying(stop=stop_after_attempt(3))
order=[]
def f1(rs): order.append('first')
def f2(rs): order.append('second')
ctl._add_action_func(f1)
ctl._add_action_func(f2)
state=RetryCallState(ctl,None,(),{})
async def drive():
    for a in list(ctl.iter_state.actions):
        await a(state)
asyncio.run(drive())
print('async_add_order_sequence',order)
assert order==['first','second']
